Pause and Stop buttons for an animated plotly chart

Source: R/utils_helpers.R
animation_buttons.Rd

Builds the updatemenus entry shown next to plotly's own Play button, used by every animated chart of the app. Pause halts the animation on the current frame; Stop halts it and jumps back to the first frame.

Usage

animation_buttons(first_frame)

Arguments

first_frame

Character. Name of the first animation frame (for these charts, the first year).

Value

A list to pass as plotly::layout(updatemenus = ...).

Examples

# an animated chart with one frame per year
d <- data.frame(x = 1:3, y = c(2, 4, 3), year = c("1960", "1961", "1962"))
p <- plotly::plot_ly(d, x = ~x, y = ~y, frame = ~year, type = "scatter", mode = "markers")
plotly::layout(p, updatemenus = animation_buttons("1960"))
